Markets.title: Ashish Kacholia, Mukul Agrawal, others invest Rs 120 crore in IPO-bound Fusion CX
Markets.summary: Ace investors Ashish Kacholia and Mukul Agrawal-backed Sanshi Fund, alongside Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance, acquired a combined 3.19% stake in Fusion CX for Rs 120 crore. This investment occurred just ahead of the company's Rs 702 crore initial public offering scheduled for October 14.

Markets.title: 9 stocks zoom up to 37% in 3 months; MFs raise stakes in September quarter
Markets.summary: Mutual funds increased their stakes in about 44 companies during the September quarter. Despite these higher holdings, most of the stocks delivered negative returns over the past three months, though nine still surged up to 37%.

Markets.title: FII selloff intensifies! Foreign investors sell Indian equities worth Rs 45,000 crore in just 6 sessions. What can reverse the trend?
Markets.summary: Foreign investors sold Rs 45,125 crore of Indian equities during the first six sessions of October, nearly matching September's total outflows. This intense selloff is driven by high US bond yields and crude oil prices, with inflation data and geopolitics likely to dictate future trends.

Markets.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: What do Shah Rukh Khan and SIFs have in common? Radhika Gupta explains
Markets.summary: Edelweiss Mutual Fund MD and CEO Radhika Gupta advised investors to approach Specialised Investment Funds (SIFs) with clear goals rather than chasing returns. Speaking at the ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0, she emphasized understanding the associated risks, costs, tax efficiency, and derivatives-based strategies of these products.

Markets.title: NTPC invites industrial partners for 26% equity in co-generation projects
Markets.summary: State-run power company NTPC Limited is seeking industrial partners to invest a 26 percent equity stake in its co-generation projects. The company has invited Expressions of Interest from commercial and industrial entities willing to participate in these ventures.

Markets.title: 9 penny stocks surged up to 315% in 6 months; 3 turned multibaggers
Markets.summary: Nine small-cap penny stocks priced under Rs 20 surged by up to 316% over a six-month period. Three of these stocks achieved multibagger status, driven by strong price momentum and significant trading volumes.

Geo-Political.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump stated that Ukraine needs a new president after Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned a diesel deal involving Russia and the United States. Zelenskyy argued that the agreement helps Moscow fund its war against Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army
Geo-Political.summary: Myanmar's struggling military junta is forcibly abducting young men from the streets to replenish its ranks. These conscripts are then sent to fight against ethnic militias and civilian resistance groups in an ongoing war of attrition.

Geo-Political.title: Delhi sees more protests as 'cockroach' group's leaders released
Geo-Political.summary: Delhi police will continue restricting access to the city center following protests over the release of leaders from a group known as the "cockroaches." Thousands of demonstrators were detained and subsequently released on Saturday.

Geo-Political.title: US justice department investigates TV networks over Trump pool coverage
Geo-Political.summary: The US Justice Department is investigating major television networks following their decision to restrict pool coverage. This restriction occurred after the White House blocked access for CNN, MS Now, and Politico.

Geo-Political.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
Geo-Political.summary: Hurricane Isaias struck the United States on Friday evening, causing four deaths and leaving thousands of people without power. The storm ripped roofs off buildings before weakening into a post-tropical cyclone.

Geo-Political.title: Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island
Geo-Political.summary: A team is traveling to a remote island to search for Amelia Earhart's airplane. They hope to solve the mystery of her disappearance in 1937.

Data & Insights.summary: This week's key economic events include the release of inflation data and the IMF's updated growth forecasts. Markets will also monitor crude oil output developments to gauge future economic direction.

Data & Insights.title: Economic think tank says govt should withdraw proposed UPI charges. Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: GTRI urged the Indian government to withdraw a proposed 0.4% fee on UPI merchant transactions exceeding ₹2,000. The think tank warned that the charge would increase consumer prices, squeeze small businesses, and reduce economic demand.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 75-100 bps in current cycle as inflation persists- SBI Capital flags December hike risk
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Capital expects the RBI to raise the repo rate by 75 to 100 basis points during the current cycle due to persistent inflation. A larger-than-usual rate hike remains a possibility for December 2026.

Data & Insights.title: Reserve Bank of India takes steps to support rupee, opens dollar window for oil companies
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is directly supplying dollars to three state-run oil companies and tightening currency derivative rules to support the falling rupee. These measures aim to reduce foreign-exchange market demand and curb volatility as the currency trades near its record low.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: rate hikes, SIP flows, Airtel’s tariffs
Data & Insights.summary: Mint's weekly Plain Facts compilation features data-based insights and charts exploring the week's top stories. Topics covered include rate hikes, SIP flows, and Airtel's tariffs.

Data & Insights.title: CEA bats for a review of loan overdue rules for MSMEs
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has urged policymakers to adjust loan overdue regulations to match the actual cash-flow cycles of MSMEs. He stated that India should avoid relying on rigid and uniform global standards for these businesses.

India.title: Delhi CJP Protest News Live Updates: "There Is Right To Protest But Should Be Within Police Act," Says Supreme Court
India.summary: About 3,000 people were detained across Delhi on Saturday during protests against the Citizenship Amendment Act. The Supreme Court stated that while there is a right to protest, demonstrations must remain within the bounds of the Police Act.

India.title: US Commander By His Side, Air Force Chief Says "They Don't Let Us Near" F-35 Jets
India.summary: Six US F-35 Lightning II fighter jets participated in India's Exercise Tarang Shakti for the first time. During the event, the Indian Air Force Chief noted that the US does not allow them close access to the aircraft.

India.title: From SIR To Protest: How Google Searches Shifted
India.summary: State-wise data reveals that Delhi recorded the highest relative search interest for the terms "Cockroach Janta Party," "Gyanesh Kumar," and "Protest." This indicates a distinct regional shift in Google search patterns across India regarding these specific topics.

India.title: OSSTET Answer Key 2026 Out: Know How To Download, Objection Details
India.summary: The Board of Secondary Education, Odisha has released the provisional answer key for OSSTET 2026 on its official website. Candidates can submit objections against the answer key until October 17, 2026.

India.title: Daughter Of Telangana Scientist Found Dead, CCTV Shows Guard Following Her
India.summary: The daughter of a scientist in Telangana was found dead under suspicious circumstances. Police formed 10 special teams to trace the security guard who was seen following her in CCTV footage before the incident.
